notes.title: Update 0.0.2 HOTFIX Fixes to Zombies and Gameplay.
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Zombies now do 5 damage per hit, adding up each round getting stronger.
[*] Zombies now sprint from 250-300 speed, normally player is 300. so they are faster and slower.
[*] Zombies now tank and soak more bullets for the sake of more points and urge to find better stronger weapons
[*] Turrets Adjusted
[*] More Glitches Patched
[*] Round Timer Adjusted
[*] More Small Changes to the overall outside area
[*] Game Download Size reduced from 43gb to 17.23gb
[*] Game Pre-Allocating issue now fixed. should not take hours to download an update.
[*] Game Textures Optimized
[*] Overall Graphics Slightly Decreased for sake of Laptop Users.
[/olist]
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944072/3700dd725020e8a620079376d8a95df868c81928.png[/img]
